text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *gasp*... *pant*... Tra... 
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Training again today... please... take 
care... *cough* *wheeze* *hack* *COUGH*!!"
choice_data_list:
What's wrong? I haven't even done anything 
yet!?

What's wrong? I haven't even done anything 
yet!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hwah...? Huh... um, what was it again—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Before social studies class... I went to 
the reference room to pick up the booklet 
the teacher asked for, but—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I happened to run into Top Road-san... and 
we were just talking about how the 
reference room is a bit messy...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Let's just do it together!" ...and then 
scrambling to clean up before class like 
"Waaah!"...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Also, in math... um, in math... I got 
called on...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Solving problems on the board... I forgot 
the easy formulas...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Brute-forcing it... tons and tons of 
calculations... Filling the blackboard... 
top to bottom... densely written—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "And then... oh, dance... Dance class..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I somehow ended up in a passion dance 
battle with El-chan...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan and everyone else were getting 
into the groove, too... And, uh... huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She nods repeatedly as she replies. In 
short, she, who is always earnest and 
hardworking... has worked incredibly hard 
today as well.
choice_data_list: (That said, if things stay like this...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *yawn*... *mumble*...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
…………――Gah!! N-No, this won't do at all! 
Not like this!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for being so soft, Trainer! 
Tsuyoshi's gonna get her head back in the 
game!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Because after all, today is another day 
where you get to watch me run...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
If I don't give it my full power, it'd be 
a waste! Hnnnnrghhh!!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I appreciate the thought, but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not just mere sentiment! I 
actually have a concrete solution in mind—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: R I G H T H E R E !

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"It's a Tsuyoshi-brand health drink! 
Making these is kind of a hobby of mine~!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
This is a brand-new creation, and I 
haven't tested it yet, but... It contains 
a Super-Duper-Secret Ingredient that 
Tachyon-san shared with me when she passed 
by!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy, it looks like it's gonna get 
crazy~!
choice_data_list: Looks like that's what's gonna happen...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that really looks far too 
high-risk just on the face of it. When I 
asked if there was anything else—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Anything else, anything else... umm... Ah, 
how about this! "Tsuyoshi-Brand Health 
Drink No. 8"!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Packed with vitamins, full of energy! It's 
absolutely perfect for recovering 
stamina~!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Or maybe... 'Tsuyoshi Brand Health Drink 
No. 5'! This one is packed full of 
mega-protein! It's guaranteed to get you 
super buff!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Do you think one of these two is better, 
Trainer? I kind of want to try the new 
one, though...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then. Which drink should I 
recommend?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Guuuughhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes...! But um, this is suuuper sour, 
so...!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Heh... heh-heh-heh-heh...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Kyuuuuuu...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi let out a tiny, 
small-animal-like squeak, but... for now, 
it seemed she had successfully restored 
some energy.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Phaaah. ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, careful... Touch me and you'll 
get burned, you know. Hey, mister...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, careful... Touch me and you'll 
get burned, you know. Hey, miss...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Well then, time to train. Heh... Guess 
I'll go "captivate" everyone again today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard later on that hard-boiled eggs 
were apparently one of the ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, it felt like it wasn't quite 
supposed to turn out this way... 
Regardless, it did lead to personal growth 
in the end."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Heh... Now that's hard-boiled—baby.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh?! A-Are you sure, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Let's take on the challenge... together!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainer-san!! All 
riiiight... *gulp* *gulp* *gulp* *gulp*!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I feel... so serene. Would one call it the 
peak of absolute calm, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. I think... I finally "get" 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi has a strikingly clear 
look on his face. It seems he's had a 
sudden flash of inspiration...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I feel... so serene. So quiet... so 
peaceful—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Quiet... shh... *snore*.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The drink didn't seem to have any 
effect... I had to lay Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi 
down on the sofa for the time being.
